observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Disciple Hirro
"Myself, Master Tallon, Master Kanjaro, we all walk the path of the Lao'Jin. We have learned to harness the positive aspects of Jin. But choosing to the path of the Lao'Jin is not always easy. Many warriors have chosen to follow Ra'Jin, succumbing to the allure of a darker power." "Just because you choose a path now does not mean you must stick to it, but the further you go, the harder it is to turn back. Approach the essence in the center of the shrine when you have made your choice."

findings.observation: Primary objective Choose Your Path differs in detail from curse and fandom objective accounts. Both variants mention Pulsating Jin Crystal (1) and describe the choice as not permanent. These remain attributed claims; branch reversibility and canonical objective enforcement remain unknown.

Description names Lao Jin and Ra Jin choices; notes describe talking to Flowing Essence of Jin and defeating Crystal Spirit (Undead, Ghost, 2 dot, aggro). Preserve creature descriptors as quest-note observations, without merging creature identities or deriving combat statistics.

The offering dialogue is explicitly attributed to vg.curse.com and describes Lao Jin and Ra Jin paths and increasing difficulty turning back. Dialogue is not proof of implemented mechanics. The curse objective contains a literal entity-encoded apostrophe; retain the cached text without silently correcting it.
Displayed Coin reward is 20 with no denomination. No item reward choice table is present; Pulsating Jin Crystal appears in objective variants and must not be converted into a choice reward.
